# mpcmp: Mean-parametrized Conway-Maxwell Poisson Regression

# mpcmp

The `mpcmp` package provides a collection of functions for estimation,
testing and diagnostic checking for the mean-parametrized Conway-Maxwell
Poisson (COM-Poisson) regression model for under- and over-dispersed
count data of [Huang
(2017)](https://doi.org/10.1177/2F1471082X17697749).

From version 0.3.0, `mpcmp` supports log-linear mean models, also allows
one to incorporate regression being linked to the dispersion parameter.

Work is progressing to include a zero-inflated Conway-Maxwell-Poisson
model.

## Installation

### Stable release on CRAN

The ***mpcmp*** package has been on
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=mpcmp) since March 2019. You
can install it from CRAN in the usual way:

``` s
install.packages("mpcmp")
library("mpcmp")
```

### Development version on Github

You can use the **devtools** package to install the development version
of **mpcmp** from [GitHub](https://github.com/thomas-fung/mpcmp):

``` s
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("thomas-fung/mpcmp")
library(mpcmp)
```

## Usage

A reference manual and some examples are available at
[thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/)

## Citation

If you use this package to analyse your data, please use the following
citation:

- Fung, T., Alwan, A., Wishart, J. and Huang, A. (2022). mpcmp:
  Mean-parametrized Conway-Maxwell Poisson Regression. R package version
  0.3.8.

From R you can use:

``` s
citation("mpcmp")
toBibtex(citation("mpcmp"))
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`AIC(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/AIC.cmp.md)
  : Akaike's Information Criterion

- [`dcomp()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/COM_Poisson_Distribution.md)
  [`pcomp()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/COM_Poisson_Distribution.md)
  [`qcomp()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/COM_Poisson_Distribution.md)
  [`rcomp()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/COM_Poisson_Distribution.md)
  : The Conway-Maxwell-Poisson (COM-Poisson) Distribution.

- [`LRTnu()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/LRTnu.md) :
  Likelihood Ratio Test for nu = 1 of a COM-Poisson model

- [`histcompPIT()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/PIT_Plot.md)
  [`qqcompPIT()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/PIT_Plot.md)
  : PIT Plots for a CMP Object

- [`gg_histcompPIT()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/PIT_ggPlot.md)
  [`gg_qqcompPIT()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/PIT_ggPlot.md)
  : ggplot version of PIT Plots for a CMP Object

- [`Z()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/Z.md) :
  Calculate the Normalizing Constant for COM-Poisson distribution

- [`attendance`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/attendance.md)
  : Attendance data set

- [`augment(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/augment.cmp.md)
  : Augment data with information from a(n) CMP model object

- [`autoplot(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/autoplot.cmp.md)
  [`gg_plot()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/autoplot.cmp.md)
  :

  Plot Diagnostic for a `glm.cmp` Object in ggplot style

- [`cmplrtest()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/cmplrtest.md)
  : Likelihood Ratio Test for nested COM-Poisson models

- [`coef(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/coef.cmp.md)
  : Extract Model Coefficients from a COM-Poisson Model Fit

- [`confint(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/confint.cmp.md)
  : Confidence Intervals for CMP Model Parameters

- [`cottonbolls`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/cottonbolls.md)
  : Cotton Bolls data set

- [`fish`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/fish.md) : Fish
  data set

- [`fitted(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/fitted.cmp.md)
  : Extract Fitted Values from a COM-Poisson Model Fit

- [`glance(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/glance.cmp.md)
  : Glance at a(n) CMP model object

- [`glm.cmp()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/glm.cmp.md)
  : Fit a Mean Parametrized Conway-Maxwell Poisson Generalized Linear
  Model

- [`logLik(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/logLik.cmp.md)
  [`print(`*`<logLik.cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/logLik.cmp.md)
  : Extract the (Maximized) Log-Likelihood from a COM-Poisson Model Fit

- [`logZ()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/logZ.md) :
  Calculate the Normalizing Constant in log scale for COM-Poisson
  distribution

- [`model.frame(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/model.frame.cmp.md)
  : Extract the Model Frame from a COM-Poisson Model Fit

- [`model.matrix(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/model.matrix.cmp.md)
  : Extract the Design Matrix from a COM-Poisson Model Fit

- [`nobs(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/nobs.cmp.md)
  : Extract the Number of Observation from a COM-Poisson Model Fit

- [`compPredProb()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/nrPIT.md)
  [`compPIT()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/nrPIT.md)
  : Non-randomized Probability Integral Transform

- [`plot(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/plot.cmp.md)
  :

  Plot Diagnostic for a `glm.cmp` Object

- [`predict(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/predict.cmp.md)
  :

  Model Predictions for a `glm.cmp` Object

- [`print(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/print.cmp.md)
  : Print Values of COM-Poisson Model

- [`print(`*`<cmp_autoplot_list>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/print.cmp_autoplot_list.md)
  :

  Print Method for a `cmp_autoplot_list` Object

- [`compnormRandPIT()`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/rPIT.md)
  : Random Normal Probability Integral Transform

- [`influence(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/regression.diagnostic.cmp.md)
  [`hatvalues(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/regression.diagnostic.cmp.md)
  [`rstandard(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/regression.diagnostic.cmp.md)
  [`cooks.distance(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/regression.diagnostic.cmp.md)
  : CMP Regression Diagnostic

- [`residuals(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/residuals.cmp.md)
  : Extract COM-Poisson Model Residuals

- [`sitophilus`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/sitophilus.md)
  : Sitophilus data set

- [`summary(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/summary.cmp.md)
  [`print(`*`<summary.cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/summary.cmp.md)
  : Summarizing COM-Poisson Model Fit

- [`takeoverbids`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/takeoverbids.md)
  : Takeover Bids data set

- [`tidy(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/tidy.cmp.md)
  : Tidy a(n) CMP model object

- [`update(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/update.cmp.md)
  : Update and Re-fit a COM-Poisson Model

- [`vcov(`*`<cmp>`*`)`](https://thomas-fung.github.io/mpcmp/reference/vcov.cmp.md)
  : Extracting the Variance-Covariance Matrix from a COM-Poisson Model
  Fit
